---
version: "0.4.0"
name: Test Atlas
colors:
  paper: "#ffffff"
  ink: "#111111"
elements:
  canvas:
    geometry: background
    color: "{colors.paper}"
---

## Overview

Human guidance for a reusable atlas family, independent of current datasets.

## Colors

Use {colors.paper} for canvas and {colors.ink} for essential text.

## Typography & Labels

Keep essential names readable; use data context to identify them.

## Composition & Density

Simplify context before crowding important marks.

## Layering & Depth

Keep context beneath subject and labels.

## Geometry & Symbols

Use clear silhouettes and distinguish meaning without color alone.

## Scale & Generalization

Use local as the base stage and preserve hierarchy in all other stages.

## Map Elements

The canvas component is a visual building block, not a required dataset.

## Do's and Don'ts

Preserve the visual identity. Do not put dataset bindings in this document.
